capabilities: Export a note as a sequence of 1080x1440 PNG pages
Automatically paginate text using real font measurement
Configure cover image, avatar, title, fonts, colors and margins in a live preview panel
Detect embedded MP4, MOV and GIF and export them as Apple Live Photos on macOS
Save output to the vault or any local folder
extras: README is in Chinese; optional OFL handwriting fonts are downloaded on demand from the author's repository and verified with SHA-256; Apple Live Photo export requires macOS 11+ and may prompt for Photos access.
motivation: The author writes long notes in Obsidian but did not want to copy content into design software and lay out pages manually, so the plugin handles covers, fonts, pagination and export locally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn long-form notes into the multi-image card sets Xiaohongshu posts require, forcing writers to re-layout each page in a separate design tool.
summary: Exports Markdown notes as paginated 3:4 Xiaohongshu image cards (1080x1440 PNG) with live preview, covers, fonts, and dynamic media support.
